findings.evidence: E06-S11 (TASK-6.9, M2/m-1, deps only TASK-1.17 and TASK-6.8) requires the 1,000,000-hand run to play Mixed/Tough/Soft at sizes 2-10 'in both cash and sit-and-go' with real style bots. The sit-and-go structure that the playtest's --game sng plays (1,500 chips, level schedule, empty seats) is only built by E05-S01/S02/S04 (TASK-5.1, 5.4, 5.2), all milestone m-2 (M3). The AC cannot pass at M2.
findings.fix: Either add deps on E05-S01/S02/S04 and move E06-S11 to M3, or restrict E06-S11#AC1 to cash at M2 and add a sit-and-go line-up coverage AC to an M3 story (E05) that carries REQ-056.2. Same issue applies to E01-S17#AC1 (outside this scope).

findings.evidence: E06-S02 (8 ACs, REQ-026/028/029) bundles four capabilities: style data-file format and validator (AC1-2), TAG mixing (AC3-4), replay-seeded generator incl. lint ban (AC5-6), replay reproduction (AC7) and the typical-player-only advice basis (AC8).
findings.fix: Split into (a) style file format + TAG mixing and (b) replay-seeded randomness and replay reproduction; keep AC8 (REQ-029.2) with (a) or with E06-S13.

findings.evidence: E06-S06 (7 ACs) mixes preset seating (AC1,2,7), unique names (AC3), two CLI option behaviours (AC4,5) and a 1,000-hand replay of every bot style (AC6, REQ-028.2). The replay AC is unrelated to line-up seating and only tags REQ-028 and REQ-062 as extras.
findings.fix: Move AC6 to E06-S02 or a replay-focused story; keep E06-S06 to preset seating, names and the --lineup option.

findings.evidence: E06-S09 (TASK-6.11) has 8 ACs plus an explicit tuning job ('Tuning of the style data files to meet the bands happens in this story') across four styles with 100,000-hand runs; not estimable or small. Reporting/CLI (AC5,6,7,8) and band proof/tuning (AC1-4) are separate capabilities.
findings.fix: Split into the --check-styles reporting/exit-code story and per-style band-tuning stories (or one tuning story per style pair), keeping the Mixed 6-max fit command as the final gate.

findings.evidence: E06-S10, E06-S11, E06-S12 and E06-S14 use a 'maintainer' persona (or a contrived 'learner wants bots proven') although requirements.md defines only the Learner user class; value is verification of REQ-027/030/055/062, not user-observable behaviour.
findings.fix: State the benefit in learner terms (e.g. 'so that the opponents I practise against are recognisable and beatable') or add a maintainer class to the requirements via the user.

findings.evidence: E06-S13#AC2 ('test code tries to modify a seated bot's style parameters, Then the attempt throws') and E06-S02#AC6 (lint reports Math.random/Date/crypto/performance.now) prescribe implementation mechanisms; the requirement only asks that parameters do not change and randomness derives from the replay code.
findings.fix: Restate as observable outcomes (parameters equal the style file after play; bot output depends only on view, replay code and seat) and keep the mechanism in Notes.

findings.evidence: E06-S12 invents CLI style tokens 'station', 'tag', 'maniac', 'rock' for --lineup while the glossary term is 'Calling station'; the token set is not documented in any AC.
findings.fix: Document the accepted style tokens in an AC of E06-S12 (and reject unknown ones) using glossary names.

findings.evidence: REQ-009.1 says Mixed styles 'cycle ... in seat order' and Tough has 'one Maniac' without saying whether the user's (randomly drawn) seat consumes a slot in the cycle or which seat gets the Tough Maniac. E06-S06 notes and E02-S05 assume cycling over bot seats only and leave the Maniac seat to a documented design choice.
findings.fix: User to confirm: cycle over bot seats only (current assumption) and that the Maniac seat in Tough is an implementation choice.

summary: All 33 clauses substantively covered by tagged ACs in E06 (or its tagged cross-epic stories). One HIGH hidden dependency: E06-S11 (M2) demands sit-and-go line-up coverage that needs E05 (M3). Several oversized stories (E06-S02, S06, S09) and weak personas on verification stories; no false claims found.
